label: docs index from docs.altinn.studio, #22090 on 575b1c3509
why: #22090 removes the docs skill's copy of llms.txt, has the model search the index that docs.altinn.studio publishes with a new web_fetch filter argument, and lists each docs page once as a source. This moves the actor_prompt and tools digests. Full check with e2e on 575b1c3509, with a clean tree. The assistant ran the same commit against the local Designer stack and the app ttd/assistant-bench, with PREVIEW_CHECK_ENABLED off as in production. Every scored behavior matches the last baseline, apart from gen_required_tools on Loop/traces, which goes from 0.889 to 1.000: gate_verdict 1.000 on Gates/scope and Gates/security, 1.000 on Planner/intake and Planner/spec, on Loop/traces 1.000 for gen_required_tools and gen_stopped_cleanly and 0.000 for gen_content_pairings, and 1.000 on bench_completed, bench_field_coverage, bench_order_integrity and bench_texts_bound. All four builds finished with success. No item asks a docs question, so the scores show that form building is unchanged, not how the assistant searches the docs. The render check was off, so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force, as the last baseline was. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
